**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

I checked for any most-favoured-nation or terms-matching covenant running against the Issuer/Depositor:

- **Text searches** for "more favorable", "favourable", "no less favorable", "most favored (nation)", "terms at least as", "offered to any other", "third party on terms" — all returned no hits.
- **Article IX (Other Agreements)** — read in full: financing statements, no-transfer/lien, expenses, receivables information, no-petition, limited recourse, limitation of liability, tax treatment, Regulation RR risk retention, Cap Collateral Account. No pricing or MFN construct.
- **Article X (Miscellaneous)** — read in full: amendments, assignment, notices, governing law/jurisdiction, jury waiver, severability, Cap Counterparty rights, Regulation AB intent. No MFN construct.
- **Servicer compensation** is a fixed rate — `"Servicing Fee Rate" means 0.75%` (p0979) — with no mechanic requiring us to match or improve on terms given to any third party.

Direction check: there is no obligation on our party (Issuer/Depositor) to offer Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to others, and nothing to match. This sits at the **preferred position** (no MFN burden on the customer side), so nothing is flagged and no edit was proposed.
